page.description: Slackware editions and architectures: compare, download official images, or prepare a USB with ROMinit CLI.
page.intro: The oldest maintained Linux distribution: a deliberately plain system installed by its own menu-driven setup, with packages kept close to upstream and no dependency resolver.
pros: Simple, predictable layout that stays close to upstream.
The full install DVD carries a complete system and package sets.
Long-lived releases with security updates for years.
Well documented in the project's own book.
cons: No dependency resolution: the administrator tracks libraries.
One ISO for the current release; no spins or flavours.
The current release dates from 2022, with -current as the rolling branch.
No screenshot with a reusable licence was confirmed, so this page is logo-only.
page.previewNote: No screenshot with a reusable licence was confirmed for Slackware; the page shows the logo only. No image was written to a USB stick and nothing was booted.
page.status: Write the install DVD ISO to a USB stick, boot it and run setup. Writing erases the stick; setup partitions and formats the target disk.
